sourceText:
Just Like Oh Henry Bars
By: Michelle La Clair
Published: Saturday, February 20, 2010 - 5:04pm

Ingredients




2 cups milk chocolate chips
2 tablespoons shortening
30 vanilla caramels, unwrapped
3 tablespoons butter
2 tablespoons water
1 cup chopped peanuts

Preparation

1 In a double boiler, melt chocolate and shortening. Stir until smooth. Remove from heat. 2 Pour 1/2 into a foil lined 8 inch square pan. 3 Refrigerate until firm. 4 Combine caramels, water and butter. 5 Place mixture on low heat until smooth. 6 Stir in nuts.  Pour into chocolate lined pan. 7 Spread evenly and top with remaining melted chocolate. 8 Refrigerate until firm, about 1 hour. 9 Cut into bite sized pieces
